## Overview

This week we will learn how to work with **tabular data** in R,
and how to visualize data with the `ggplot2` package of the `tidyverse`.

## Lectures & Learning goals

Some of the things you will learn this week:

#### [Working with tabular data in R](./w13a_data-wrangling.qmd)

- The vector data structure, R's main data types, and comparisons
- How to subset, sort, modify, summarize, reshape, and join data frames,
  by exploring an RNA-seq gene count table

#### [Data visualization with ggplot2](./w13b_data-viz.qmd)

- Basic syntax of the `ggplot()` function, including aesthetic mappings
- How to create scatter plots, bar graphs, and box plots
- How to customize plots with colors, labels, and themes
- How to export plots to files
